Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Meteor is d4builds' second-best Sorcerer build for Season 15 (B, behind Firewall A) [https://d4builds.gg/tierlist/ - 2026-09-16] and B on both Maxroll lists [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/endgame-tier-list - 2026-09-16] [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/push-tier-list - 2026-09-16]; InfinityBuilds does not list it [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/tier-list - 2026-09-16]. The layout here is Maxroll's Season 15 guide (Northwar, updated for Season 15 on 14 September 2026; planner 9f4b3s0q) [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/meteor-sorcerer-guide - 2026-09-16] [https://planners.maxroll.gg/profiles/d4/9f4b3s0q - 2026-09-16], the only Season 15 Meteor layout published: d4builds' Meteor detail page is still 'Meteor Sorc (S14)', last updated June 26, 2026 [https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/d4builds-a3254/databases/(default)/documents/builds/85fbebdc-26fd-4d79-b295-2d9234b7dcd7 - 2026-09-16]. Starfall Coronet triples each Meteor, Air Burst adds six Meteorites to each, and Berú of the Threefold casts Meteor and Blizzard for free; a Legendary seal with 'Mana when a Mastery Skill is Triggered' pays for the Resource Damage Bonus upgrade. Disagreement with the site's tie-break: a points-weighted count across the three references would rank Static Field Blizzard (d4builds C, InfinityBuilds A, Maxroll A/B, all S15 pages) above Meteor. Untested here; Maxroll's own verdict: 'not the strongest META build at the moment'. All four stages are Maxroll profiles (Starter, Midgame, Endgame; pushing is the guide's Seal of the Diamond Mind upgrade on the Endgame gear).

Rotation
  1. Spam Meteor, wait half a second for its Overpower, then Teleport two or three times; keep Ice Armor up, press Blizzard yourself only when Berú of the Threefold is on cooldown, cast Ball Lightning every 5-10 seconds to hold the Threefold bonus, and use Inferno for six instant Overpower stacks.
Variants

Leveling — Spam Meteor, wait half a second for its Overpower, then Teleport two or three times; keep Ice Armor up; press Blizzard yourself only when Berú of the Threefold is on cooldown; cast Ball Lightning every 5-10 seconds to hold the Threefold bonus; Inferno for six instant Overpower stacks (Maxroll Skills prose) [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/meteor-sorcerer-guide - 2026-09-16].
Move on when Move on once Raiment of the Infinite (Bartuc) and Esu's Heirloom (Astaroth) drop and you can reach 95% sheet Critical Strike Chance with Esu's tempered and masterworked on Movement Speed.

Early Endgame — Spam Meteor, wait half a second for its Overpower, then Teleport two or three times; keep Ice Armor up; press Blizzard yourself only when Berú of the Threefold is on cooldown; cast Ball Lightning every 5-10 seconds to hold the Threefold bonus; Inferno for six instant Overpower stacks (Maxroll Skills prose) [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/meteor-sorcerer-guide - 2026-09-16].
Move on when Take the endgame layout when the Coronet, Raiment, Tibault's Will and Esu's Heirloom are all Mythic (Maxroll mythic priority: Raiment of the Infinite '43% toughness', Starfall Coronet '15% damage', Esu's Heirloom '~10% damage').

Late Endgame — Spam Meteor, wait half a second for its Overpower, then Teleport two or three times; keep Ice Armor up; press Blizzard yourself only when Berú of the Threefold is on cooldown; cast Ball Lightning every 5-10 seconds to hold the Threefold bonus; Inferno for six instant Overpower stacks (Maxroll Skills prose) [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/meteor-sorcerer-guide - 2026-09-16].
Move on when Push only once a Seal of the Diamond Mind rolls the Mastery-mana affix (Maxroll: 'good luck finding that').

Pushing — Spam Meteor, wait half a second for its Overpower, then Teleport two or three times; keep Ice Armor up; press Blizzard yourself only when Berú of the Threefold is on cooldown; cast Ball Lightning every 5-10 seconds to hold the Threefold bonus; Inferno for six instant Overpower stacks (Maxroll Skills prose) [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/meteor-sorcerer-guide - 2026-09-16].

Stat requirements
  • Critical Strike Chance: 95% on the character sheet - Searing Heat adds the last 5% (Maxroll)
  • Esu's Heirloom: tempered and masterworked Movement Speed 'gets you to 50%', plus 10% from Teleport, toward the crit cap (Maxroll)

How to run them

Maxroll: 'Subo for maphack and Opening Fire bonus', 'Raheir with Bastion on Injured for extra safety'; skill picks from the planner's mercenary tree, matched against the 3.2.1 game data [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/meteor-sorcerer-guide - 2026-09-16] [https://planners.maxroll.gg/profiles/d4/9f4b3s0q - 2026-09-16]. Raheir casts Bastion on the Injured condition (the planner's Injured trigger), not on a Sorcerer skill, so no opportunity trigger skill is recorded. d4builds' Meteor page is Season 14 and not used. No mercenary change in 3.2.1 or Hotfix 1 [https://maxroll.gg/d4/resources/mercenaries-overview - 2026-09-16].

Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Meteor is d4builds' second-best Sorcerer build for Season 15 (B, behind Firewall A) [https://d4builds.gg/tierlist/ - 2026-09-16] and B on both Maxroll lists [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/endgame-tier-list - 2026-09-16] [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/push-tier-list - 2026-09-16]; InfinityBuilds does not list it [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/tier-list - 2026-09-16]. The layout here is Maxroll's Season 15 guide (Northwar, updated for Season 15 on 14 September 2026; planner 9f4b3s0q) [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/meteor-sorcerer-guide - 2026-09-16] [https://planners.maxroll.gg/profiles/d4/9f4b3s0q - 2026-09-16], the only Season 15 Meteor layout published: d4builds' Meteor detail page is still 'Meteor Sorc (S14)', last updated June 26, 2026 [https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/d4builds-a3254/databases/(default)/documents/builds/85fbebdc-26fd-4d79-b295-2d9234b7dcd7 - 2026-09-16]. Starfall Coronet triples each Meteor, Air Burst adds six Meteorites to each, and Berú of the Threefold casts Meteor and Blizzard for free; a Legendary seal with 'Mana when a Mastery Skill is Triggered' pays for the Resource Damage Bonus upgrade. Disagreement with the site's tie-break: a points-weighted count across the three references would rank Static Field Blizzard (d4builds C, InfinityBuilds A, Maxroll A/B, all S15 pages) above Meteor. Untested here; Maxroll's own verdict: 'not the strongest META build at the moment'. All four stages are Maxroll profiles (Starter, Midgame, Endgame; pushing is the guide's Seal of the Diamond Mind upgrade on the Endgame gear).

Rotation
  1. Spam Meteor, wait half a second for its Overpower, then Teleport two or three times; keep Ice Armor up, press Blizzard yourself only when Berú of the Threefold is on cooldown, cast Ball Lightning every 5-10 seconds to hold the Threefold bonus, and use Inferno for six instant Overpower stacks.
Variants

Leveling — Spam Meteor, wait half a second for its Overpower, then Teleport two or three times; keep Ice Armor up; press Blizzard yourself only when Berú of the Threefold is on cooldown; cast Ball Lightning every 5-10 seconds to hold the Threefold bonus; Inferno for six instant Overpower stacks (Maxroll Skills prose) [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/meteor-sorcerer-guide - 2026-09-16].
Move on when Move on once Raiment of the Infinite (Bartuc) and Esu's Heirloom (Astaroth) drop and you can reach 95% sheet Critical Strike Chance with Esu's tempered and masterworked on Movement Speed.

Early Endgame — Spam Meteor, wait half a second for its Overpower, then Teleport two or three times; keep Ice Armor up; press Blizzard yourself only when Berú of the Threefold is on cooldown; cast Ball Lightning every 5-10 seconds to hold the Threefold bonus; Inferno for six instant Overpower stacks (Maxroll Skills prose) [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/meteor-sorcerer-guide - 2026-09-16].
Move on when Take the endgame layout when the Coronet, Raiment, Tibault's Will and Esu's Heirloom are all Mythic (Maxroll mythic priority: Raiment of the Infinite '43% toughness', Starfall Coronet '15% damage', Esu's Heirloom '~10% damage').

Late Endgame — Spam Meteor, wait half a second for its Overpower, then Teleport two or three times; keep Ice Armor up; press Blizzard yourself only when Berú of the Threefold is on cooldown; cast Ball Lightning every 5-10 seconds to hold the Threefold bonus; Inferno for six instant Overpower stacks (Maxroll Skills prose) [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/meteor-sorcerer-guide - 2026-09-16].
Move on when Push only once a Seal of the Diamond Mind rolls the Mastery-mana affix (Maxroll: 'good luck finding that').

Pushing — Spam Meteor, wait half a second for its Overpower, then Teleport two or three times; keep Ice Armor up; press Blizzard yourself only when Berú of the Threefold is on cooldown; cast Ball Lightning every 5-10 seconds to hold the Threefold bonus; Inferno for six instant Overpower stacks (Maxroll Skills prose) [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/meteor-sorcerer-guide - 2026-09-16].

Stat requirements
  • Critical Strike Chance: 95% on the character sheet - Searing Heat adds the last 5% (Maxroll)
  • Esu's Heirloom: tempered and masterworked Movement Speed 'gets you to 50%', plus 10% from Teleport, toward the crit cap (Maxroll)

Reasoning

Hypothesis3.2.1 raises Meteor 180% to 240%, Shooting Star 306% to 408%, Air Burst 45% to 88% and Comet 270% to 360%, and the core stat scalar to 1.625 per 10 Intelligence, while the Fire cuts (Enchantment Master 60%[x], Pyromaniac 15%, Elemental Constellation 45-60%[x]) touch nodes this layout either does not use or keeps only for Mastery triggers. Because Starfall Coronet makes each Meteor drop 3 Meteors and Air Burst adds 6 Meteorites to each ('21 objects... each time we push the Meteor button', every one a Mastery Skill), a Legendary Horadric Seal with 'Mana when a Mastery Skill is Triggered' should refund the Resource Damage Bonus upgrade's Mana cost, and Berú of the Threefold's free Meteor/Blizzard casts should roughly double the object count without extra input. Pushing should then scale by adding 3-piece Berú of the Cauldron through Seal of the Diamond Mind ('more damage and more toughness'), provided the seal still rolls the Mastery-mana affix. Sources: official 3.2.1 notes [https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24295394/celebrate-30-years-of-diablo-in-season-of-hell-s-legacy - 2026-09-16]; Maxroll Meteor guide [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/meteor-sorcerer-guide - 2026-09-16].
Confidencemedium
How to test it(1) Mana: 'look at your Mana while spamming Meteor at an enemy: if it goes all the way to full between casts, then you need more Max Mana, if it doesn't, then you have too much' (Maxroll) - do this before judging damage. (2) Critical Strike Chance cap: Esu's Heirloom + Teleport + Qua must reach 95% sheet crit (Searing Heat adds 5%); below that the Anguish/crit gear under-performs. (3) Banished Lord's Talisman was reworked in 3.2.1 (still usable by Sorcerer); its live value is unconfirmed (data-mined 86.667-100 vs official 130-150%, the knowledge base) - compare it against a sixth Threefold charm. (4) Maxroll's prose still mentions keeping Hydra off the bar 'because of Aspect of Elemental Constellation' although no S15 profile equips that aspect - treat that line as stale and verify Hydra Enchantment: Behemoth uptime on Ice Armor. (5) Bug note from the guide: taking Ball Lightning side upgrades removes Meteor's side upgrades - check the tree after every respec. (6) Seal of the Diamond Mind push step: only worth it with the Mastery-mana affix; measure Pit clear time against the Legendary seal. [https://maxroll.gg/d4/build-guides/meteor-sorcerer-guide - 2026-09-16]

Blizzard

MasteryCold

Rank 1/15

Mana Cost: 40

Lucky Hit Chance: 33%

Call forth a frigid blizzard that deals 350% Frostbite damage and continually Chills enemies for 100% over 4 seconds.

Modifiers

  • ExposureBlizzard's duration is increased to 6 seconds and it makes enemies Vulnerable.
  • Seek and Duration BonusBlizzard now seeks enemies and its duration is increased by 50%.
  • BarrierBlizzard grants you a Barrier that absorbs 0.5% of your Maximum Life for 4 seconds every second for each affected enemy.
Cold Damage

Meteor

MasteryFire

Rank 15/15

Mana Cost: 40

Lucky Hit Chance: 40%

Call down a meteor that crashes into enemies, dealing 240% damage and an additional 60% Burning damage over 3 seconds.

Modifiers

  • Resource Damage BonusMeteor now consumes all your remaining Mana on Cast, dealing 2%[x] increased damage for each point of extra Mana spent.
  • OverpowerMeteor's Impact damage now grants 1 stack of Overpower per enemy hit.
  • Air BurstMeteor rains down 6 Meteorites before the final impact that each deal 87.5% damage each, but Meteor no longer deals Burning damage.
Fire Damage

Ball Lightning

MasteryLightning

Rank 1/15

Mana Cost: 30

Lucky Hit Chance: 5%

Discharge a ball of lightning that slowly moves forward and continuously zaps enemies, dealing 120% damage per second.

Modifiers

  • Crackling EnergyBall Lightning forms 3 Crackling Energy when it dissipates.
  • OrbitalBall Lightning orbits you and now deals 130 – 173% damage around you per second.
  • FerocityBall Lightning grants 1 stack of Ferocity.
Lightning Damage

Teleport

DefensiveLightningMobility

Rank 6/15

Cooldown: 10 seconds

Lucky Hit Chance: 65%

Transform into lightning and surge to the target location, dealing 35% damage around you upon arrival.

Modifiers

  • BlazeTeleport becomes a Pyromancy Skill that deals 59.5% Fire damage. Teleport now only dashes you forward a short distance and will consume 1 stack of Overpower to refund its Cooldown.
  • Movement SpeedTeleport increases your Movement Speed by 10%[+] for 4 seconds.
  • Crackling EnergyTeleport forms 2 Crackling Energy at the ending location.
Lightning Damage

Ice Armor

DefensiveCold

Rank 15/15

Cooldown: 20 seconds

A Barrier of ice forms around you for 4 seconds, absorbing 30% of your Maximum Life ({x}) in damage.

Modifiers

  • PermafrostIce Armor grants Unstoppable for 1 second and increases your Armor by 50% while active.
  • Cooldown ReductionIce Armor's Cooldown is reduced to 16 seconds.
  • Duration Bonus and BarrierIce Armor's duration is increased to 5 seconds and its Barrier amount is increased by 20%[x].
Cold Damage

Inferno

UltimateFire

Rank 1/15

Cooldown: 24 seconds

Lucky Hit Chance: 10%

Summon a fiery serpent that deals 21.25% damage and Burns enemies for 85% damage over 4 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.

  • Cooldown ReductionInferno's Cooldown is reduced to 12 seconds, but it now also costs 30 Mana.

Share a Drink

Scorched Earth

PassiveSubo

Mastermind

Opening Fire

Pin Cushion

PassiveSubo

Trip Mines

Iconic skillSubo

Cooldown: 18 seconds

Subo scatters 3 explosive traps that each arm after 1.0 secondseconds. When an enemy moves within range of one, it explodes for 300% Physical damage and Knocks Down enemies for 1.5 secondseconds.

Cover Fire

Iconic skillSubo

Cooldown: 20 seconds

Subo charges a countless volley of arrows, then unleashes it over your position for 140% Physical damage that Slows enemies by 50% for 4 seconds.

Explosive Charge

Iconic skillSubo

Cooldown: 22 seconds

Subo fires 4 Explosive Charges that stick to enemies. Each explodes after 6.5 seconds or when their target dies, dealing 60% Physical damage.

Snipe

Iconic skillSubo

Cooldown: 20 seconds

Subo charges a massive piercing bolt, then unleashes it forwards for 450% Physical damage that Knocks Back enemies.

Wire Trap

Core skillSubo

Cooldown: 10 seconds

Weapon: Bow

Basic Attack: Heavy Shot

Subo places a concussive trap that arms after 0.8 secondseconds. When an enemy moves within range, it explodes for 80% Physical damage and Stuns enemies for 2.0 secondseconds.

Selecting a Mercenary Core Skill alters their wielded Weapon and Basic Attack.

Subo fires a toughened arrow at an enemy, dealing 80% Physical damage with a 30% chance to Stun for 1.0 secondseconds.

Molotov

Core skillSubo

Cooldown: 11 seconds

Weapon: Crossbow

Basic Attack: Salvo

Subo tosses an incendiary at an enemy, dealing 10% Physical damage and Stunning them for 1.0 |4second;seconds before exploding into flames. For the next 5 seconds, enemies within the area repeatedly take 36% Burning damage over 3 seconds.
